notes.title: No More Bugs, Just Loot! 🚀 Danger Scavenger Update is Here!
notes.content:
🚀 Danger Scavenger Update is LIVE! 🚀
[build #2.10.0]

Hey, Scavengers! We know it’s been a while since the last update, but trust us - we’ve been hard at work, fighting bugs like they’re rogue A.I. minions trying to take over the skyline. This update is all about squashing those frustrating glitches and ensuring your scavenging adventures are as smooth as Tru’s hammer swing. So, what’s new? We're glad you asked!

🏍️ Bike Drama Be Gone!
For some players, pulling up to a new building ready to smash some bots turned into an unplanned bike ride - stuck and going nowhere. Awkward. Well, not anymore! We've fixed it, so you can dismount like a pro and get straight to scavenging. No more "perma-bike" moments to slow you down.

🛠️ Workshop Woes? Not Anymore!
Previously, if you dared to move during the victory cutscene, the workshop wouldn't open. That’s like being stuck in a hardware store with the doors locked. But not anymore! The workshop is now ready for action, no matter how wiggly you are. Build, craft, and prep for your next mission without a hitch.

💥 Runtime Error? We’re on it! Ah, the infamous Runtime Error C++... it’s like that boss that just won’t stay down. We’ve located one of its hideouts and dealt some severe damage. While we’re sure we’ve reduced its appearances, we’re still looking for ghostly glitches that might try to respawn. If you see one, you know what to do - report it, and we’ll send the Scavenger squad after it.

🎉 We’re Listening - And We Care
We’ve read your reviews. We’ve seen the pain points. And we’re doing something about it. We’re fully committed to giving you the best possible Danger Scavenger experience. You deserve a fast, fun, and fluid ride, and we’re ensuring you get it.

That’s it for now, but stay tuned - more to come. Remember, we’re always watching (in a friendly, non-A.I. way) and constantly improving.

BE A REBEL! ✊Star Drifters team ⭐🚀

notes.title: Star Drifters recap
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/37547bab3d30a82d7db45227a874bfff4b8d5fde.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 👋

you probably wonder why there’s a graphic with a screen taken from the Nintendo Switch 🎮 version of Danger Scavenger. The answer is simple - we wanted to make an announcement summarizing our work done between January and July of 2022 - when we’re writing these words, Driftland is still our most popular franchise. 🌲

Unfortunately, nothing really happened during this period in Driftland camp. Nonetheless, you can get the game in many discounts that pop up every once in a while (usually during Steam/GOG offers/events). But, y’know, there’s always something cookin’. ♨ Be patient.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/2f8424598909bae3c60b575fc912d21ea396a31e.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/718650/Driftland_The_Magic_Revival/

[h1]Danger Scavenger[/h1]

That’s where the fun starts. First of all - we’re flattered that DS is featured on the back of the [b]Atari VCS box[/b]. Ta-da! 🎉

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/68ec192ba36b75171cc891d762706687b362de7d.png[/img]

When [b]Steam Deck [/b]was on its way, we did everything to make sure that the game would run perfectly on the “second” handheld from day one. After that, we received an official Steam Deck verification in May. Speaking about the “first” handheld, just a reminder - [b]Danger Scavenger[/b] is available on [b]PC, PS4, XONE, Switch, VCS[/b] and [b]XSX[/b]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/c15dfd345141b02b9005abd96832472137d76cb0.jpg[/img]

We’re always looking for new ways of approaching the titles that we already published. When we started talking with the [b]Tilt Five[/b] team, we knew that their [b]Holographic Gaming System[/b] would be a great place for a skyscraper-based roguelike. That’s why we made a dedicated [b]DLC [/b]to bring the catchphrase “a new level of the 3D vibrant holographic environment" to DS rooftops! 🌆

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ed22b76333715d0e33298d2ff77347e56d27d0f0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/20123869e38e7254ea40fdd7bd43f147f7d12d26.jpg[/img]

[h1]Lumencraft[/h1]

When devs from [b]2Dynamic Games[/b] started the playtests, we were convinced that approx. 200 people will check out the game during the two weeks of that phase. Well, there were [b]1312 participants[/b]. The feedback submitted by playtesters gave us a new perspective on the game. We knew that we chose the right project for publishing.

The [b]Lumencraft [/b]section of this Steam announcement will be the longest one, because the game’s still in Early Access and currently it’s a project no. 1 in our catalog. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713810/Lumencraft/

After the first week of EA we reached the 20k copies milestone. None of us expected that this will happen so fast, so Kuba Wójcik came up with a meme idea.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/be9a75f964c9606a8e5a8f469a4aa6c4266c71f7.png[/img]

We won’t share how many copies were sold, but we can say that as the indie publishers - we’re satisfied. 😏

Today, exactly 3 months after the start of Early Access (which happened April 13th, 2022) we would like to thank everyone who wrote a review on Steam. The numbers speak for themselves. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/34129bc80a88a4be9bad0b73d6afeac1e0ffac06.png[/img]

During the playtests, “2Ds” organized the [b]MAKE A MAP, WIN A PRIZE[/b] contest. 10 maps were published via Steam Workshop - 3 guys won Danger Scavenger and Driftland: The Magic Revival Steam keys. The ideas behind the contest were continued in the Maps Shootout series. When we’re writing these words there are [b]123 maps submitted to the Workshop[/b]. 🤯

Lots of them are truly pieces of art that reshape Lumencraft’s gameplay. The summary of all Maps Shootouts installments can be found in our Stories highlights on our Instagram.

What’s more, the game was shown at this year’s:
[b]- European Game Showcase during GDC;
- PAX East;
- Digital Dragons 🐲.[/b]

To this day, the [b]2Dynamic Games[/b] team is working closely with the game’s community. When [b]Early Access[/b] starts (after the playtests), the developers published:
- 3 hotfixes;
- 4 small updates;
- two major updates;
- and we’re pretty much sure we forgot about something. 💊

They added new weapons, buildings, monsters, maps and scenarios, textures, new UI, and fixed A LOT. Lumencraft is now more approachable to semi-casual players, but it does not collide with the hardcore players - there are extremely hard maps available to enjoy (or suffer a bit). 😈 

That’s all for today.
[h1]The second recap will be published at the end of 2022.[/h1]
Or maybe at the beginning of 2022?

Let’s see what happens. Great things are here, but also great things are yet to come.

Support the IndieDev!
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.content:
[code][h3]> Who are you? 
> That's irrelevant. 
> What's your name? 
> The less you know, the longer you'll live. 
> What matters is that you're deadly efficient, highly skilled, and invisible to indifferent citizens – traits that are more than desirable when you're one of the outcasts, the Scavenger. 
> And you're here to kick some corporate a$$.[/h3][/code]
[h3]Aloha Scavengers![/h3]

We’re so happy to finally officially release Danger Scavenger to you! 

But first things first; [h3]Thank all of you for supporting our game during the Early Access period! [/h3]
It’s been quite a ride! 🤪🎢 

This 2.0.2 update brings some minor improvements and fixes, including the method of assigning keys/buttons in the controller settings has changed.
But the most important change is:
[h1]:resetloop: LEADERBOARDS RESET[/h1]
The game has undergone many changes, including the difficulty level, so if you want to make history as the best of the best,[b] today is your chance[/b]!

We made the game available in [b]Early Access on[/b] [b]Steam, GOG[/b], and the upcoming console - [b]Atari VCS[/b] before its official premiere, exclusively for its supporters. Thanks to feedback from our engaged community, we were able to add a lot of interesting new features and fine-tune the game to your expectations.

[previewyoutube=z8rjMXCAJOM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]:powerOMON: During the crazy 9 months of Early Access, the game got 19 updates, the most important of which are:[/h3]
[list]
[*]improved animation smoothness and overall optimization (Update 1.1.0)
[*]added in-game workshops for crafting during the run (Update 1.1.0) 
[*]two game modes to choose from: arcade and roguelike (Update 1.2.1)
[*]diversifying level shapes (Update 1.3.0)
[*]added secrets (Update 1.3.0)
[*]added curse system - daemons (Update 1.4.0)
[*]fixed, improved, and extended the co-op game mode (Update 1.5.0)
[*]added new game+ in roguelike mode (Update 1.5.0)
[*]added leaderboards (Update 1.6.0)
[*]faster, stronger, TURBO - adjusted speed and game balance (Update 1.8.0)
[*]new content added: 2 more characters, more weapons, items etc. (Update 1.9.666)

[*]game improvements and new content including better AI (Update 1.9.9)
[*]beta polishing, bug fixes, UI improvements (Update 2.0.X+)
[/list]
[h3]:ctm_gamepad: Thanks to the updates, the list of the [b]MAIN FEATURES[/b] has been extended:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dynamic risk-reward gameplay: choose your path wisely, face the challenges, and become the hero you've always wanted to be! Or... take an easier path and return with nothing.
[*] Collect scrap and craft the equipment out of it. You can customize each weapon to your individual needs using the crafting system.
[*] Unexpected item combinations to discover during your adventures. Design your perfect strategy by many trials and errors, obviously resulting in many deaths.
[*] 6 unique Scavengers - each one has their skills and style of dealing with problems: stealth, strategy, [*] rapid-fire action, or maybe a mix of them? You decide!

[*] Team up and fight the enemy robots in Cooperation Mode
[*] Immersive soundtrack composed by Szymon Weiss.
[*] Danger Scavenger, now available on PC (Steam, GOG, itch.io, Stove, nVidia GeForce Now, Humble Store), Atari VCS, and Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.3.0 - The Power of Surprise
notes.content:
[h3]The power of surprise cannot be overestimated.[/h3]

In the last 6 updates, we focused on improving and adding new features to the single-player gameplay. However, one of the most important problems remained unresolved - the generic shape of the levels, which are generated completely randomly, which made them erm... let's put it this way -  less exciting. [b]Until today :-)[/b]

In this update, you will find many new features that will diversify the gameplay, make the levels appealing, and will often surprise you. Levels still generate randomly, but we've changed the way they are generated, which now creates lots of surprising shapes, holes, and branches. At the same time, each skyscraper gained its own personality. Let's get straight to the point:

[h2]Update Notes 1.3.0[/h2]

[h3]New features:[/h3]

:loottreasure: [b]Secret Rooms [/b]

There are many new surprises waiting for you on the rooftops, but from now on they will also be waiting to be discovered below the surface. Please focus because you may miss the entrance that will give you a full backpack of the precious stuff. This feature is still in Work in Progress but we're sure you'll like it already.

:tbrick: [b]The new look of the generated levels [/b]

We have prepared a completely new look for all levels. Of course, we still keep the spirit of the roguelike games, and each level is generated randomly. Only this time, we focused on making more interesting shapes that add variety and smoot gameplay to the game. 

:Workforce: [b]Improving look and layout of objects[/b]

Along with the new look of the generated levels, we also focused on improving the appearance of the props. 

:questhunterspeed: [b]Speed Boost[/b]

To speed up the whole game, we have added a unique speed boost when the player eliminates all opponents on each level.

:paintbrush: [b]Graphics improvements[/b]

Responding to many opinions about the repetitiveness of the levels, we have prepared many new graphic improvements that will allow you to see more differences between each skyscraper. You will find new elements of the environment, a more transparent look of the floor on the Oriental skyscraper, and the variety of the whole Diesel skyscraper.

🏗️ [b]Other  improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] we've improved the response time attack of the turrets,
[*] when the character has a full life, the first-aid kits remain unused,
[*] in the Hacking Room, enemies appear more often and over a larger area
[/list]

🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrectly saved/stored items in the equipment,

[*] Fixed items cloning bug

[*] Fixed the black screen error caused by pressing the alt + TAB button combination
[/list]

Later this month, the following updates will come: the Curse system, some new animations, a co-op update, New Game+ in Hardcore mode, and Leaderboards.

Danger Scavenger will take part in the [b]Indie Arena Booth[/b], which will be held at Gamescom Online!

This is a great honor for us, especially since we will also take part in the vote for The Best Independent Game at Gamescom.

notes.content:
[h1]This update changes everything! [/h1]
[h3]Your feedback motivated us to work hard, introduce significant changes, and improve the game to use its great potential, which you often wrote about.[/h3]
First of all, we introduced two game modes. No matter which one you choose, both bring a lot of changes to the game. Arcade - for twin-stick shooter lovers and Hardcore for roguelike enthusiasts. The first gives fast, dynamic gameplay in which the player increases his abilities and arsenal in each subsequent run. The second mode ... just doesn't forgive mistakes :-)

[h2]Update Notes 1.1.0[/h2]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[b]🕹️ ARCADE mode[/b]
For twin-stick shooter lovers
[list]
[*] Upon death, the player keeps the top 3 items, currently used weapon, and scrap
[*] Pick-ups don't disappear over time
[*] The player attracts all pickups once the level is cleared
[*] Characters share deposited items
[*] Unlocked characters start from different buildings
[/list]

[b]☠️ HARDCORE mode[/b]
For roguelike enthusiasts
[list]
[*] Lose everything upon death 
[*] Pick-ups disappear over time
[*] The order of the buildings is the same regardless of the character selected
[/list]

[b]🛠️in-game WORKSHOPS[/b]
From now on, you don't have to go through the entire skyscraper to upgrade your weapons or items. Workshops located at selected levels allow crafting during the mission.

[b]💥 easier to DESTROY props[/b]
No more bothersome breaking through objects on the roofs. With this update, one melee blow does the trick

[b]🏙️ Skyscrapers gain more of their own characteristics[/b]
We have started work on a more diverse generation of individual skyscrapers so as to further diversify their characteristics. The first visible effect in this update is the different landing levels at the beginning of the mission. However, this is only the beginning of changes in this direction. The next ones will come in the next updates.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] the pickups could not be picked up when you had to mouse over the tooltip
[*] improved camera smoothness - work in progress (we'll optimize game more soon)
[*] screen tearing fix - valid v-sync
[*] "SET DEFAULT SETTINGS" now resets resolution and refresh to windows desktop values
[*] The game saves keybindings correctly
[*] minor bug fixes
[/list]

And please forgive us for a little joke, which is the picture 🤠 for this update, we had to somehow catch your attention to the revolutionary changes that we have just introduced to Danger Scavenger, which are still only a prelude to what we plan in the next updates.

If you find any bug or have ideas for new game features or improvements, be sure to let us know on the Steam Community or Discord!

notes.title: New Alert Scavengers! Support us!
notes.content:
Dear Scavengers,
 
Sometimes you need to take one step back, in order to go two steps forward. Creating [b]Danger Scavenger[/b] we wanted to provide you the best roguelike game that we would like to play. 

Unfortunately, after the release, it turned out that almost half of the players have different expectations about our project. Not all of the decisions we made proved to be the right solution. Some of them made us closer to a [b]twin-stick shooter[/b], and we have a lot of players who don't like the system known from roguelike games. 

On the other hand, we have received a lot of [b]valuable feedbac[/b]k from our community, which showed us that our game can evolve. That's why we decided that [b]Danger Scavenger[/b] will be further developed with you - our great community, so we decided to switch to [b]Early Access[/b]. Now every player can influence how our game will eventually look like. It was not an easy decision - Danger Scavenger is a project of my life, which was previously created as [b]Turbo Island Purger[/b]. Cooperation with [b]Star Drifters[/b] allowed me to expand it with many new mechanics, which were not planned before. That is why we are very keen to provide you with a project that you will be happy.

We are entering [b]Early Access[/b] with a fully playable game. Our goal is to introduce an improvement and additional mechanics to satisfy two groups of players: roguelike fans and twin-stick shooter fans. Seemingly it is a difficult task, that's why we want to offer the possibility of choosing the game mode: roguelike or arcade (which is currently missing) and refining the balance of both modes. Also, it turned out that crafting, which we thought was a nice addition, is very important for players who from the very beginning of the game would like to be able to improve their items and weapons. That is why we would like to introduce frequent updates and be open to the ideas of our community, which honestly inspired us to move to early access.

[previewyoutube=X-BZ6Rfr1R8;full][/previewyoutube]

This will be short but intensive early access. The full version will be released no later than the console version before the end of 2020. Because we have a lot of mechanics already pre-prepared, we assume that by the end of August 2020 the game will have a set of new features, and we will develop nuances together with the community gameplay and additional content.

We decided to expand the game with:
[list]
[*]two game modes to choose from: arcade and roguelike
[*]new game + in roguelike mode
[*]leaderboards
[*]workshops for crafting while playing on skyscrapers
[*]diversifying level shapes
[*]curse system
[*]secrets
[*]new content (items, weapons, etc.)
[*]optimization
[/list]
We need to have as close contact with our players as possible. We will be at the players’ disposal on [b]Steam Community[/b], [b][url=https://discord.gg/SEts56G]Discord[/url][/b], and social media ([b][url=https://www.facebook.com/StarDrifters.games/]Facebook [/url][/b]& [b][url=https://twitter.com/stardrifters]Twitter[/url][/b]).

We would like to grant access to the development branch to the most engaged players who express such a desire. The public version will also be updated very often, but we will try to always be a complete game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

Thank you and remember to be a rebel! :rebellion:
Piotr Wolk and Star Drifters team.

notes.title: Update notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback, and we apologize to those who had problems with the game.

We thoroughly analyze all feedback and reviews to draw conclusions and improve the game. It is very important to us because our goal is to make every player enjoy more gameplay. We put a lot of heart into the creation of Danger Scavenger, and we are sure that we will be able to improve the game so that everyone can share this joy with us.

Therefore, we are preparing a major update, which will be available in a few days, but until then, we will publish the bug fixes.

[h1]Update notes 1.0.2[/h1]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] game settings - the game saves settings upon exit including resolution and key bindings
[*] Incorrectly saved player score used for unlocks - returning to the game sometimes reset the accumulated player score needed for unlocks
[*] incorrectly counted buildings - some achievements were not awarded due to incorrectly counted building passes
[*] camera and deaths in cooperation mode - fixed in co-op
[*] display mode change crash - in rare cases it could cause a crash
[*] settings reset - in rare cases settings could back to the defaults itself
[*] 'items count exceeded' popup on a motorbike - it could happen after “save & quit” & “continue” until open the workshop window
[*] minor gfx bugs on levels - fixed
[*] peaceful Biotech boss -  sometimes the boss on the roof of the Biotech skyscraper did not attack the player
[*] "Clumsy - fall from rooftop 10 times" achievement fixed
[*] “You did it! - Finish the game” achievement fixed
[*] fixed minor bugs in resolution changing
[/list]

Added:
[list]
[*] New Scavenger -  Keiko is now unlocked after defeating 1st building 
[*] New Scavenger -  Rhino is now unlocked after defeating 2nd building
[*] toggle controller's vibrations - On/Off
[*] performance optimization improving framerate
[/list]

Be a rebel!
-SD team
